query: A planner wants to raise a capacity request with a complete program brief. How long does review take?
context: Standard Request Window: Requests with a complete program brief: reviewed within 5 business days. Expedited requests: reviewed within 2 business days. Requests inside 30 days of the required start: escalated to the site planning lead.
ground_truth: Five business days for a request with a complete program brief. Expedited requests are reviewed within two business days.

query: What happens if a capacity request comes in less than 30 days before the required start date?
context: Standard Request Window: Requests inside 30 days of the required start: escalated to the site planning lead. Incomplete Requests: Requests without a program, site, duration, and required start date are returned.
ground_truth: It is escalated to the site planning lead.

query: How much is five weeks of premium contract capacity at expedited priority?
context: Transfer Tiers: Standard tier (packaging and secondary operations): $50K per week. Advanced tier (oral solid dose manufacturing): $120K per week. Premium tier (sterile manufacturing): $300K per week. Priority Multipliers: Standard priority: 1.00x. Expedited priority: 1.25x. Example Calculation: 5 weeks of premium capacity at expedited priority = 5 x $300K x 1.25 = $1,875K.
ground_truth: $1,875K: 5 weeks x $300K per week x 1.25 for expedited priority.

query: How far ahead does a planner need to request a production slot?
context: Booking Rules: Confirm the slot is open with the planning desk before committing materials. Request a slot at least 4 weeks before the required start date. Changeover time is reserved automatically either side of a production slot.
ground_truth: At least 4 weeks before the required start date, and the slot should be confirmed with the planning desk before materials are committed.

query: Can we cover a sterile shortfall using spare capacity at Calderwood?
context: Headroom is not interchangeable between sites. Calderwood holds most of the spare capacity but cannot package, and Brightwater is the only sterile site. A sterile shortfall cannot be covered internally and must go to a contract manufacturer.
ground_truth: No. Calderwood does granulation and blending, and Brightwater is the only sterile site. A sterile shortfall cannot be covered internally and has to go to a contract manufacturer.

query: Which site has the most spare capacity, and how much is it?
context: Ashford: rated 180, committed 172, headroom 8. Brightwater: rated 90, committed 88, headroom 2. Calderwood: rated 120, committed 96, headroom 24. Total rated capacity: 390 batches per quarter. Total committed: 356. Total headroom: 34.
ground_truth: Calderwood, with 24 batches per quarter of headroom. Ashford has 8 and Brightwater has 2, giving 34 across the network.

context: Kestrel Contract Manufacturing, supplier code CMO-KES, transfer tier Standard. Qualification status: Conditional - approved for packaging only, with additional testing. Audit: Last audited November 2025, one finding closed February 2026. Constraint: Conditional qualification; cannot take manufacturing work.
ground_truth: Conditional. Kestrel is approved for packaging only, with additional testing, and cannot take manufacturing work.

query: Which contract manufacturers could fast-track us inside a three-month window?
context: Halden Biologics: Premium tier, $300K per week, fast-track window 4 months, Qualified. Norvent Pharma Services: Advanced tier, $120K per week, fast-track window 3 months, Qualified. Kestrel Contract Manufacturing: Standard tier, $50K per week, fast-track window 6 weeks, Conditional.
ground_truth: Norvent Pharma Services at 3 months and Kestrel Contract Manufacturing at 6 weeks. Halden Biologics needs 4 months, so it cannot meet a three-month window.

query: What are the planning desk hours?
context: Planning Desk Hours: Monday-Friday: 8:00 AM - 6:00 PM (site local time). Weekend cover: on-call planner for launch-critical programs only. Site technical desk: opens 30 minutes before the planning desk and closes 30 minutes after.
ground_truth: Monday to Friday, 8:00 AM to 6:00 PM site local time. At weekends there is an on-call planner for launch-critical programs only.

query: Who do I contact if I think my staff account has been compromised?
context: Security incidents (lost device, phishing, account compromise): security@caldova.example, 24/7 hotline (555) 200-4599. MES or account issues: IT Helpdesk at ithelp@caldova.example or (555) 200-4580.
ground_truth: Report it to security@caldova.example or the 24/7 security hotline on (555) 200-4599.
